metadata.description: In the run-up to the second phase of the Lok Sabha Election in Tripura, campaigning has intensified, particularly in tribal-dominated regions. With 89 Lok Sabha seats, including 6 scheduled tribe seats, at stake, political parties have been vigorously wooing voters. Candidates have focused on addressing local issues such as infrastructure development, employment opportunities, and healthcare access. Tribal communities, comprising a significant portion of the electorate, have been actively engaged in discussions and rallies organized by various political parties. Key issues like land rights, cultural preservation, and tribal welfare have been prominently featured in campaign agendas. As the campaign trail winds down on the eve of the voting day, anticipation is high among voters as they prepare to cast their ballots and shape the political landscape of Tripura.
